CommunityApplications.Profile: unraid-plugin-docker-model packages the Docker Model Runner CLI plugin for Unraid. The plugin adds the "docker model" command to the Unraid Docker CLI, so AI models can be pulled, run and served locally. The upstream binary is redistributed unmodified from Docker's official apt artifact and is verified against the download.docker.com Packages index on every build. The repository contains the plugin definition, the Slackware packaging, the WebGUI page and the build and verification scripts.
